blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q2(iv): 2 tan 30° / (1 - tan² 30°) is equal to:
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र2(iv): 2 tan 30° / (1 - tan² 30°) किसके बराबर है?
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q2(iv): 2 tan 30° / (1 - tan² 30°) કોના બરાબર છે?
blocks.explanation_hi: मान √3 आता है, जो tan 60° है।
blocks.explanation_gu: કિંમત √3 મળે છે, જે tan 60° છે.

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q4(i): True or False: sin (A + B) = sin A + sin B
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र4(i): सत्य या असत्य: sin (A + B) = sin A + sin B
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q4(i): સાચું કે ખોટું: sin (A + B) = sin A + sin B
blocks.explanation: False. For example, if A=30° and B=60°, sin (30+60) = sin 90° = 1. But sin 30° + sin 60° = 1/2 + √3/2 ≠ 1.

blocks.question: Ex 8.2 Q4(ii): True or False: The value of sin θ increases as θ increases (from 0° to 90°).
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.2 प्र4(ii): सत्य या असत्य: θ के बढ़ने पर sin θ का मान बढ़ता है।
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.2 Q4(ii): સાચું કે ખોટું: θ વધવા સાથે sin θ નું મૂલ્ય વધે છે.
blocks.explanation: True. sin 0° = 0, sin 30° = 0.5, sin 90° = 1. The value increases from 0 to 1.
blocks.explanation_hi: सत्य। मान 0 से 1 तक बढ़ता है।

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q3(i): Evaluate 9 sec² A - 9 tan² A
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र3(i): मान ज्ञात करें: 9 sec² A - 9 tan² A
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q3(i): કિંમત શોધો: 9 sec² A - 9 tan² A
blocks.explanation: = 9 (sec² A - tan² A). Using the identity sec² A - tan² A = 1, the value is 9(1) = 9.

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q3(ii): Evaluate (1 + tan θ + sec θ) (1 + cot θ - cosec θ)
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र3(ii): मान ज्ञात करें: (1 + tan θ + sec θ) (1 + cot θ - cosec θ)
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q3(ii): કિંમત શોધો: (1 + tan θ + sec θ) (1 + cot θ - cosec θ)
blocks.explanation: Convert all to sin and cos. LHS = (1 + sin/cos + 1/cos) (1 + cos/sin - 1/sin) = [(cos+sin+1)/cos] [(sin+cos-1)/sin] = [(sin+cos)² - 1²] / (sin cos) = (sin² + cos² + 2sincos - 1) / (sincos) = (1 + 2sincos - 1) / sincos = 2.
blocks.explanation_hi: sin और cos में बदलकर हल करने पर उत्तर 2 आता है।
blocks.explanation_gu: sin અને cos માં ફેરવીને સાદું રૂપ આપતાં 2 મળે છે.

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q3(iii): Evaluate (sec A + tan A) (1 - sin A)
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र3(iii): मान ज्ञात करें: (sec A + tan A) (1 - sin A)
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q3(iii): કિંમત શોધો: (sec A + tan A) (1 - sin A)
blocks.explanation: =(1/cos A + sin A/cos A) (1 - sin A) = [(1 + sin A)/cos A] (1 - sin A) = (1 - sin² A) / cos A = (cos² A) / cos A = cos A.
blocks.explanation_hi: (1 - sin² A) / cos A = cos² A / cos A = cos A।
blocks.explanation_gu: (1 - sin² A) / cos A = cos² A / cos A = cos A.

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q3(iv): Evaluate (1 + tan² A) / (1 + cot² A)
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र3(iv): मान ज्ञात करें: (1 + tan² A) / (1 + cot² A)
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q3(iv): કિંમત શોધો: (1 + tan² A) / (1 + cot² A)
blocks.explanation: 1 + tan² A = sec² A. 1 + cot² A = cosec² A. So sec² A / cosec² A = (1/cos² A) / (1/sin² A) = sin² A / cos² A = tan² A.
blocks.explanation_hi: sec² A / cosec² A = sin² A / cos² A = tan² A।
blocks.explanation_gu: sec² A / cosec² A = sin² A / cos² A = tan² A.

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q4(i): Prove identity: (cosec θ - cot θ)² is equal to which of the following?
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र4(i): सिद्ध करें: (cosec θ - cot θ)² किसके बराबर है?
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q4(i): સાબિત કરો: (cosec θ - cot θ)² કોના બરાબર છે?
blocks.explanation: (1/sin θ - cos θ/sin θ)² = ((1 - cos θ)/sin θ)² = (1 - cos θ)² / sin² θ = (1 - cos θ)² / (1 - cos² θ) = (1 - cos θ)² / [(1 - cos θ)(1 + cos θ)] = (1 - cos θ) / (1 + cos θ).
blocks.explanation_hi: (1 - cos θ)² / (1 - cos² θ) = (1 - cos θ)/(1 + cos θ)।
blocks.explanation_gu: (1 - cos θ)² / (1 - cos² θ) = (1 - cos θ)/(1 + cos θ).

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q4(ii): Simplify [cos A / (1 + sin A)] + [(1 + sin A) / cos A]
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र4(ii): सरल करें: [cos A / (1 + sin A)] + [(1 + sin A) / cos A]
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q4(ii): સાદું રૂપ આપો: [cos A / (1 + sin A)] + [(1 + sin A) / cos A]
blocks.explanation: LCM = cos A (1 + sin A). Numerator = cos² A + (1 + sin A)² = cos² A + 1 + sin² A + 2 sin A = 1 + 1 + 2 sin A = 2 + 2 sin A = 2(1 + sin A). Fraction = 2(1 + sin A) / [cos A(1 + sin A)] = 2/cos A = 2 sec A.
blocks.explanation_hi: अंश = 2(1+sin A)। परिणाम = 2/cos A = 2 sec A।
blocks.explanation_gu: અંશ = 2(1+sin A). પરિણામ = 2/cos A = 2 sec A.

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q4(vi): Simplify √[ (1 + sin A) / (1 - sin A) ]
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र4(vi): सरल करें: √[ (1 + sin A) / (1 - sin A) ]
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q4(vi): સાદું રૂપ આપો: √[ (1 + sin A) / (1 - sin A) ]
blocks.explanation: Multiply numerator and denominator inside root by (1+sin A). Root of [(1+sin A)² / (1-sin² A)] = (1+sin A) / √cos² A = (1+sin A) / cos A = 1/cos A + sin A/cos A = sec A + tan A.
blocks.explanation_hi: रूट के अंदर (1+sin A) से गुणा करें। (1+sin A)/cos A = sec A + tan A।
blocks.explanation_gu: વર્ગમૂળમાં (1+sin A) વડે ગુણો. (1+sin A)/cos A = sec A + tan A.

blocks.question: Ex 8.3 Q4(viii): Simplify (sin A + cosec A)² + (cos A + sec A)²
blocks.question_hi: अभ्यास 8.3 प्र4(viii): सरल करें: (sin A + cosec A)² + (cos A + sec A)²
blocks.question_gu: ક. 8.3 Q4(viii): સાદું રૂપ આપો: (sin A + cosec A)² + (cos A + sec A)²
blocks.explanation: Expand: (sin² A + cosec² A + 2) + (cos² A + sec² A + 2) = (sin² A + cos² A) + 4 + cosec² A + sec² A = 1 + 4 + (1 + cot² A) + (1 + tan² A) = 7 + tan² A + cot² A.
blocks.explanation_hi: 1 + 4 + (1+cot² A) + (1+tan² A) = 7 + tan² A + cot² A।
blocks.explanation_gu: 1 + 4 + (1+cot² A) + (1+tan² A) = 7 + tan² A + cot² A.
